options.name: datafile_dest
options.description: The path where PDB datafiles will be placed

options.name: default_tablespace
options.description: Set PDB default permanent tablespace when opening/ensuring state.

options.name: default_tablespace_type
options.description: Set PDB default tablespace type when opening/ensuring state.

options.name: default_temp_tablespace
options.description: Set PDB default temporary tablespace when opening/ensuring state.

options.name: dsn
options.description: Oracle DSN/TNS alias. When provided, it takes precedence over hostname/port/service_name.

options.name: file_name_convert
options.description: Mapping of source file paths to target file paths for CREATE PLUGGABLE DATABASE file_name_convert clause.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The host of the database

options.name: mode
options.description: The mode with which to connect to the database

options.name: nocopy
options.description: Skip copying datafiles when plugging in a PDB from an XML descriptor (NOCOPY clause). Use when the datafiles are already in the correct location and only the XML metadata needs to be imported. Only meaningful when plug_file is set.

options.name: open
options.description: Desired open state when C(state=present). C(true) opens the PDB read-write, C(false) closes it (MOUNTED), C(null) leaves open state unchanged.

options.name: oracle_home
options.description: The ORACLE_HOME to use

options.name: password
options.description: The password to connect to the database

options.name: pdb_admin_password
options.description: The password for the PDB admin user

options.name: pdb_admin_username
options.description: The username for the PDB admin user

options.name: pdb_name
options.description: The name of the PDB

options.name: plug_file
options.description: Path to XML descriptor file for plug-in/unplug operations. Mutually exclusive with sourcedb.

options.name: port
options.description: The listener port to connect to the database

options.name: restricted
options.description: Open the PDB in restricted mode. Valid only with C(state=present) and C(open=true).

options.name: roles
options.description: List of roles granted to the PDB admin user during PDB creation from seed.

options.name: save_state
options.description: Save PDB state across instance restarts.

options.name: service_name
options.description: The service name to connect to the database

options.name: service_name_convert
options.description: Mapping of source service names to target service names for service_name_convert clause.

options.name: session_container
options.description: Target PDB name for ALTER SESSION SET CONTAINER on connect. Useful when connecting to CDB root but executing queries in a specific PDB.

options.name: snapshot_copy
options.description: Use SNAPSHOT COPY when cloning from another PDB (requires compatible storage)

options.name: sourcedb
options.description: Source PDB to clone from. Mutually exclusive with plug_file. Use clone_from as a more explicit alias.

options.name: state
options.description: The intended state of the PDB. present - create PDB if absent; optionally use open/restricted to control runtime open mode. read_write - create if absent then open read-write. closed - create if absent then leave/put it in MOUNTED state. read_only - create if absent then open read-only. absent - drop the PDB including datafiles. unplugged - unplug the PDB to an XML file (plug_file required). status - return current PDB status.

options.name: timezone
options.description: Set PDB DBTIMEZONE when opening/ensuring state.

options.name: user
options.description: The database username to connect to the database
